spec2def(itss.dll itss.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(itss registry itss.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# itss.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/itss-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(itss_shims OBJECT chm_lib.c lzx.c itss.c moniker.c protocol.c storage.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(itss_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register oldnames liburlmon libshlwapi libole32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(itss_shims)
add_dependencies(itss_shims wineheaders)
set(ITSS_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/itss/itss_r.o)
add_cargo_module(itss itss-cargo itss.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS itss_shims psdk itss_r ${ITSS_REUSED} uuid_sources)
